messages:
maya (PM): quick sync — want a compact pattern for staged experiments + circuit-breaker + per-tenant kill-switch for any model-routing or API surface change. low blast, easy ops.

ev an (eng): typo: evan :) idea: controller that runs a rollout_plan with ordered phases. each phase = {regions, slice%, duration, health_gates}. controller emits two RTTs: plan-intent and applied-state. it should support explicit cohort overrides for A/B tests.

rico (sre): criteria: automatic circuit-breaker if (error_rate_rel > 3x baseline && absolute_error_rate > 2%) OR (p95_latency > baseline + 200ms). require persistence for 3 consecutive 1m windows before breaker trips. breaker actions: 1) per-tenant kill-switch (0% traffic) 2) region pause 3) degrade-mode.

zoe (product): product asks: define labels and success metrics per-experiment. A/B should be independent from rollout slices (we run A on cohort X and rollout slice on public traffic). also need standard comms template for customers if their tenant is affected.

ev an (eng): controller API (proposal): POST /v1/rollouts {plan_id, feature, phases[], cohort_map?} PATCH /v1/rollouts/{id}/pause PATCH /v1/rollouts/{id}/override {tenant_id, action}. CI will create plan records and we store event stream in audit table.

min (ops): Dedicated customers: must have toggle to disable auto-kill per contract. if disabled, controller should auto-notify ops channel and open a P1 if breaker condition. we need an approval flow: /ops/approve-bypass with signed justification.

rico (sre): telemetry: emit events: rollout.started, phase.enter, phase.exit, circuit_breaker.tripped, tenant_kill.applied, rollout.aborted. wire to Console alerts and to #eng-oncall. add fast query to list active rollouts and per-tenant state.

helm-bot: deployment: rollout rp_20240501_09 started -> regions: [us-west-2, eu-central-1], phase1=0.2% 30m -> phase2=2% 60m.

maya (PM): runbook sketch: 1) detect: alert fires -> oncall inspects Console. 2) triage: confirm signal (compare to baselines, recent config changes). 3) action: controller may auto-trip; oncall can run `rictl rollout pause --id rp_...` or `rictl tenant revert --tenant T123`. 4) postmortem: if any tenant_kill applied -> notify customer-success + create RCA.

ev an (eng): implementation notes: use append-only ordered log for intents (Kafka). controller reads intents, writes diffs to per-region caches, data-plane acknowledges. ensure idempotency: each intent has monotonic sequence number.

zoe (product): launch gates: a) e2e test harness for staging model-switch b) canary in two regions for 48h without circuit trips c) telemetry and customer-comm template done d) Dedicated opt-out documented.

min (ops): security: audit trail must include operator identity for manual overrides. CLI should require mfa when doing emergency revert for customers with SSO.

rico (sre): SLA guardrail: if controller triggers >3 tenant_kill events for same release within 24h -> freeze that release across accounts and require postmortem before restart.

maya (PM): timeline: 2 weeks prototype (controller + simple gates), 1 week ops/CLI + Dedicated bypass flow, 1 week telemetry + docs + customer comms. shipping target: next model switch.

evan (eng): I'll post design doc to #eng-platform today. planning to mock API and the kafka flow.

zoe (product): I'll prepare experiment naming conventions and success metric templates.

min (ops): I'll draft Dedicated bypass checklist and SSO/MFA exceptions.

rico (sre): I'll prepare gate thresholds and a short incident playbook for oncall.

maya (PM): thanks all. follow-ups: drop blockers here, and tag me for approvals. :white_check_mark:
